text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — priv/VPC onboarding for Aegis Labs. Quick stability-runway check after today's smoke: key outstanding items are KMS key policy approval, audit-log delivery path, and service-account IAM scope. Can infra confirm which of these are blocking go-live?
jonas_eng: saw 3 failing smoke checks earlier, two look infra-related. Pushed logs to the temp bucket. Will triage now. :mag:
liam_infra: KMS note — we need Aegis to approve a restricted key policy that allows our router role to Decrypt only. Without that, runtime can't unwrap model keys. @kevin_customer can you confirm you can sign off?
kevin_customer: We can approve. Need the policy snippet and I want Encrypt removed (decrypt-only).
jonas_eng: here’s the snippet we suggest:
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFW:role/redwood-router" },
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
liam_infra: +1 to decrypt-only. Also an ops caveat: if the key has a rotation window overlapping our maintenance windows we may need a fallback key alias — flagging now.
sarah_custops: quick renewal note — if go-live shifts >2w we escalate to AM for an exec touchpoint. I'm tracking as a conditional risk in the renewal tracker.
maria_cs: action items I'm capturing: 1) kevin approve kms decrypt-only policy, 2) infra to confirm svc-account IAM perms (least-priv), 3) define audit log delivery plan to SIEM. I'll drop a confluence page with the checklist after this thread.
kevin_customer: Policy approved (decrypt-only). Added comment: please do not include kms:Encrypt on that principal.
jonas_eng: got the approval, thanks. I'll update the deployment manifest to reference the decrypt-only alias and re-run smoke tonight. deploy-bot will post statuses.
deploy-bot: smoke rerun queued (job id 98321). ETA about 33m.
deploy-bot: job 98321 complete — 2 failing checks remain: ingress health and audit-forwarding. See logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/98321 :eyes:
liam_infra: ingress failure looks like TLS on the edge-proxy — cert chain not found for aegis-edge. @kevin_customer, were certs uploaded to the 'aegis-cert-store' S3 location?
kevin_customer: ah — missed that step earlier. Uploading certs now to aegis-cert-store (public bucket) — ETA ~12m.
maria_cs: thanks. I’ll run a 1-hr post-fix check-in at 15:00 PT. If both ingress and audit-forwarding clear, we mark the go-live window as open and I’ll update the renewal status to ‘on-track’. If not, I’ll schedule the AM touchpoint per Sarah’s note. :white_check_mark:
